description: Mutes and unmutes a signal on each trigger, the chance of muting set by a knob

params.text: Sets the chance of muting at each trigger, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: The signal that is passed or silenced, 16 channels at most
A rising edge draws again on the probability, either muting the signal or letting it through
Adds to the prob knob, 10V adding the full 100%

outputs.text: The input signal, either passed through or silenced

menu: fade in/out — replaces the instant mute with a fade, the slider under it setting the fade length from 5ms to 10 seconds
